Status: Implementation and own suite complete; review-stable
Scope: Bounded skeleton attachment preflight; no new IPC/action, live game or package build

Claims.Finding: Selects first system BAR type2/sklt payload and calls installer3EAB20.
Claims.Limitations: Does not validate arbitrary later mod file contents.

Claims.Finding: Publishes sklt payload at RVA2AE5798; full eight-byte body is runtime pinned.
Claims.Limitations: Installed pointer is checked against owning BAR each preflight.

Claims.Finding: First matching type/tag entry wins; link flags are not filtered by this search.
Claims.Limitations: Guard rejects malformed first payload even if a later duplicate looks valid.

Claims.Finding: Preceding allocation header uses rounded payload length, magic0x23234141 and kind1.
Claims.Limitations: An allocation header is structural ownership evidence, not an allocation-success prediction.

Claims.Finding: Loaded BAR fixup stores encoded container self at header+8.
Claims.Limitations: Guard accepts currently loaded/fixed-up system BAR only.

Claims.Finding: Decodes parent actor object+8 and returns object BYTE+7 as skeleton key.
Claims.Limitations: This is distinct from weapon group WORD+78; no semantic name invented for the key.

Claims.Finding: Uses signed count+4, rows at+8, stride8 and bsearch against scalar key.
Claims.Limitations: Guard demands complete bounded rows and sorted unique keys.

Claims.Finding: Comparator returns the DWORD subtraction key minus row key; signed return interpretation permits greater-key distance0x80000000 inclusive.
Claims.Limitations: Larger distances invert comparison sign and are rejected.

Claims.Finding: Reads signed row+4+2*hand without checking search-result null; missing row faults at3D7635.
Claims.Limitations: No negative-joint restriction or later model bone-count claim.

Claims.Finding: Constructs resolved hand0 for all targets and resolved hand1 for forms1..6 or10.
Claims.Limitations: Trainer exposes only targets0..6; this evidence does not expand forms.

Claims.Finding: Zero weapon group/item skips model resolution; offhand reads form record chosen by signed object+87.
Claims.Limitations: Target character/form identity and planned replacement must agree with that record.

Claims.Finding: went[group] plus Item WORD+4 indexes a model DWORD; zero offset returns zero.
Claims.Limitations: Bounded mapping is not model-file content validation.

Claims.Finding: Nonempty wmst[(2*group+hand)*32] enters motion load/link and skeleton lookup; empty name skips attachment lookup.
Claims.Limitations: Empty name does not skip weapon allocation or other constructor paths.

Tests: after-Revert revalidation and no automatic retry
Limitations: No proof of effective mod-resolved MDLX/MSET content or actual model joint bounds.
Later native allocations can still fail.
Foreign asynchronous writes after Begin are outside preflight ownership.
Reported current Final Form crash was not reproduced.
Static evidence reused and original-byte verified; no fresh IDA-body claim while analysis readiness was false.
